high_level_description: The image is a social media post with a light purple background. At the top of the image, there is a faint watermark of the U.S. Great Seal, which includes an eagle and the phrase "E PLURIBUS UNUM" (Latin for "Out of many, one"). Below the seal, there is a quote in bold blue text that reads: "Trust Women. Trust them to know what is in their best interest." The quote is attributed to Vice President Kamala Harris, as indicated by the text below the quote. At the bottom of the image, there is a small logo of the White House, depicted within
